# Koenig Childhood Cancer Foundation (KCCF)

> Koenig Childhood Cancer Foundation (KCCF) provides life-saving financial and emotional support to children battling cancer and their families. "No child should fight cancer alone." 501(c)(3) public charity (EIN 84-4892279), New York, NY. Founded in 2020 by Elana Koenig at age 11, with the $900 in her piggy bank, after her own cancer treatment at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center.

## What KCCF does

- Emergency financial aid for families of children in active cancer treatment
- Crazy Socks gift bags delivered to children fighting cancer in hospitals
- KCCF Camp: an international summer camp in Azerbaijan for children with cancer and their siblings
- KCCF is a 100% volunteer-run organization

## For companies: Crazy Socks Gift Making – Team-Building Event

A corporate team-building event: the team hears Elana's story, then packs Crazy Socks gift bags for children fighting cancer in hospitals. Partners have included Meta, Bank of America, Amazon, Aflac, Forvis Mazars, Sumitomo Mitsui Bank and UBS.

- [Plan a gift bag event](https://thekccf.org/crazy-socks)

## Book Elana to speak

Elana Koenig is a keynote speaker at schools, companies, health events, galas and graduations. Her keynote message: how she turned her pain into purpose.

- [Book Elana to speak](https://thekccf.org/get-involved)

## For donors

Tax-deductible gifts online (Zeffy, PayPal, Venmo), plus stock, crypto, donor-advised funds, wire, check and workplace giving (Benevity).

- [Donate](https://thekccf.org/donate)
- [Financials](https://thekccf.org/financials)

## Programs

- [KCCF Camp](https://thekccf.org/camp): international summer camp in Azerbaijan for children with cancer and their siblings, free for families
- [Family Aid](https://thekccf.org/aid): help with co-pays, rent or mortgage, lodging, travel and food for families of children in active treatment; applications through the hospital social worker
